_note: The guided front screen. Wings group needs; each option points at items that already exist in the per-OS data (match is by exact item name; a 'js:' prefix means the JUMPSTART list, otherwise CATS). 'items' maps an OS id, or '*' for every OS; an OS with no entry (and no '*') simply doesn't show that option. Nothing here adds an app: it only describes and points.
